rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: Raises exception LMS-031 if p_window_days is null or outside 1..90 inclusive.
rules.notes: Declared parameter is int; no default.

rules.title: Initialize counters
rules.statement: Sets p_posted and p_skipped to 0 before processing.

rules.title: Skip NPA loans
rules.statement: Increments p_skipped and skips any loan where asset_class = 'NPA'.

rules.title: Require benchmark code
rules.statement: Raises exception LMS-005 if benchmark_code is null on a floating-rate loan.

rules.title: Next reset date calculation
rules.statement: Computes v_months as completed reset cycles since disb_date plus one reset_months interval; sets v_next to disb_date plus that many months (no rounding of the date itself).
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age); integer division on v_months.

rules.title: Window filter
rules.statement: Skips loan if v_next > p_as_of + p_window_days.

rules.title: Notice date weekday adjustment
rules.statement: Sets v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday, plus 1 day if Sunday, else unchanged.
rules.notes: Uses extract(dow); only handles weekend cases.

rules.title: New rate lookup
rules.statement: v_new = (latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where benchmark_code matches and effective_date <= v_next, or 0) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0).
rules.notes: Missing benchmark treated as 0; no precision declared on numeric.

rules.title: Old rate lookup
rules.statement: v_old = (latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where benchmark_code matches and effective_date <= start of prior reset cycle, or 0) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0).

rules.title: Skip small change or duplicate notice
rules.statement: Increments p_skipped and skips if abs(v_new - v_old) < 0.25 or a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists with note containing 'reset ' || v_next.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE pattern; no rounding call.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Inserts loan_ledger row with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new, entry_date = v_notice, and note 'reset ' || v_next || ' from ' || v_old || ' to ' || v_new; increments p_posted.
rules.notes: Amount column receives the new rate value.

open_questions: Confirm that only Saturday/Sunday adjustments are intended for v_notice and that other holidays are ignored.
Confirm that missing benchmark rates are deliberately treated as zero rather than raising an error.
Confirm that the duplicate-notice check relies solely on the LIKE pattern in the note column.
Confirm intended behaviour when disb_date, reset_months or spread_pct are null.
